results.summary_before: This design is a clock frequency divider that generates several divided clock signals from a user-selected modulo value. Eight input pins set the modulo M, and the bidirectional pins output clocks divided by 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128 along with the raw modulo M pulse, while the eight outputs drive a 7-segment display. Internally a counter counts to M-1 and its terminal signal clocks a 7-bit counter whose stages provide the divided outputs. Testing only requires setting the modulo value on the dedicated input switches.
